slides.title: Google Business Profile se *calls badhao*. 5 cheezein.
slides.sub: "Near me" search mein dikhne ke liye. Sab free.

slides.title: 1. Sahi *primary category*
slides.sub: "Dentist" vs "Dental clinic" jaisa chhota farak bhi search mein farak daalta hai. Competitor kya use kar raha hai, dekho.

slides.title: 2. *Timing* hamesha sahi
slides.sub: Google ne "open" dikhaya aur dukaan band mili = bura review. Tyohar ki special timing bhi daalo.

slides.title: 3. *Asli photos*, har mahine
slides.sub: Dukaan, team, kaam. Stock photo nahi. Naye photos profile ko active dikhate hain.

slides.title: 4. *Har review* ka reply + 5. Services list
slides.sub: Achhe review ko thanks, bure ko solution. Services mein price range likho.

slides.title: Aapka profile *kitna strong* hai?
slides.sub: Comment AUDIT, hum free check karke batayenge kya missing hai.

caption:
"Near me" search mein aapka business dikhta hai? Google Business Profile ki 5 cheezein jo calls badhati hain. 📍

1️⃣ Sahi primary category
2️⃣ Timing sahi (tyohar ki special timing bhi)
3️⃣ Har mahine asli photos
4️⃣ Har review ka reply, 24 ghante mein
5️⃣ Services + price range

Sab free hai. 30 minute ka kaam.

Save karo 🔖
